title: 「It is not ... but ... that ...」強調對比句
titleZh: 「It is not ... but ... that ...」強調對比句
titleEn: Using “It is not X but Y that ...”

source.file: Sentence Structure 189 -「It is not ... but ... that ...」強調對比句.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: It + be + not + X + but + Y + that + rest of clause

formulas.formula: It + be + not + X + but + Y + that + rest of clause

example: It is not talent but discipline that determines long-term success.
exampleZh: 決定長遠成功的，不是天分，而是紀律。

examples.en: It is not talent but discipline that determines long-term success.
examples.zh: 決定長遠成功的，不是天分，而是紀律。
examples.highlight: It is not talent but discipline that determines long-term success.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：It + be + not + X + but + Y + that + rest of clause。

rules.zh: X 和 Y 通常必須屬於相同的文法類別，例如兩個人物、兩件事物、兩個時間、兩個地點、兩個原因 或兩種方法。
rules.en: X and Y must perform the same grammatical function X and Y should normally be two people, two things, two times, two places, two reasons, two methods or two other comparable elements. Correct: It was not Amy but Ben that answered the question. Correct: It was not on Monday but on Tuesday that the shop reopened.
examples: X and Y must perform the same grammatical function
X and Y should normally be two people, two things, two times, two places, two reasons, two
methods or two other comparable elements.
Correct: It was not Amy but Ben that answered the question.
Correct: It was not on Monday but on Tuesday that the shop reopened.

rules.zh: 把不正確、較不重要或要否定的內容放在 not 後面；把真正正確或重要的內容放在 but 後面。
rules.en: Put the rejected idea after “not” Place the incorrect, less important or rejected idea after not. Place the correct or important idea after but.
examples: Put the rejected idea after “not”
Place the incorrect, less important or rejected idea after not. Place the correct or important idea

rules.zh: 不要在 that 子句重複 X 或 Y；只保留原句其餘部分。
rules.en: Do not repeat X or Y in the that-clause; keep only the remaining information.
examples: Do not repeat X or Y in the that-clause
The that-clause contains the remainder of the original sentence. Do not repeat the emphasised
Original: Discipline determines long-term success.
Correct: It is not talent but discipline that determines long-term success.
Incorrect: It is not talent but discipline that discipline determines long-term success.

rules.zh: 按照時間選擇 is 或 was。現在情況、一般事實及不少未來安排通常使用 It is；已完成的過去事件 則使用 It was。
rules.en: Choose “is” or “was” according to the meaning Use It is for present facts, general truths and many future arrangements. Use It was when referring to a completed past event.
examples: Choose “is” or “was” according to the meaning
Use It is for present facts, general truths and many future arrangements. Use It was when
referring to a completed past event.

rules.zh: 在一般英語中，強調人物時有時可以使用 who。不過，本練習一律使用 that，讓學生集中練習同 一個目標句型。
rules.en: Use “that” throughout this exercise In ordinary English, who may sometimes be used when the emphasised element is a person. However, this exercise uses that consistently so that students can practise one clear target structure.
examples: Use “that” throughout this exercise
In ordinary English, who may sometimes be used when the emphasised element is a person.
However, this exercise uses that consistently so that students can practise one clear target

rules.zh: 這個句型應該否定一個可能性，並強調另一個可能性。如果 X 和 Y 同樣正確，便不適合使用這個 句型。
rules.en: Use the structure only when there is a genuine contrast The sentence should reject one possibility and emphasise another. Do not use it when X and Y are both equally true.
examples: Use the structure only when there is a genuine contrast
The sentence should reject one possibility and emphasise another. Do not use it when X and Y
are both equally true.

benefits.zh: 這個句型可以立即告訴聽者或讀者，哪個想法不正確，以及哪個才是正確答案。
benefits.en: It corrects misunderstandings clearly This structure immediately tells the listener or reader which idea is wrong and which idea is correct.

benefits.zh: but 後面的內容會得到特別強調。因此，當你想突出真正的原因、人物、問題、解決方法或決定因 素時，這個句型非常實用。
benefits.en: It places strong emphasis on the real point The words after but receive special attention. This is useful when you want to highlight the real cause, person, problem, solution or deciding factor.

benefits.zh: 你不需要分開寫兩句，也可以把錯誤想法和正確重點合併成一句有組織的句子。 Compare 比較 天分並不決定長遠成功。紀律才會。 決定長遠成功的，不是天分，而是紀律。
benefits.en: It combines a correction and a complete message Instead of writing two separate sentences, you can combine the rejected idea and the correct idea into one organised sentence. Talent does not determine long-term success. Discipline does. It is not talent but discipline that determines long-term success.

benefits.zh: 這個句型適合用於作文、簡報、討論及職場溝通，因為你可以先糾正常見的誤解，再清楚提出自 己的主要論點。
benefits.en: It strengthens explanations and arguments This structure is useful in essays, presentations, discussions and workplace communication because it allows you to challenge a common assumption before presenting your main argument.

benefits.zh: 記住 It is not X but Y that... 這個框架後，你可以更快組織口語答案，不需要每次都由第一個字 重新構思整句。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame Once you remember It is not X but Y that..., you can organise an answer quickly without planning every word from the beginning.
